workClassPolicy.assignment: Assign only from the selected catalog scenario on each human terminal classification, before interpreting latency or answer content. Missing assignments are unknown; conflicting ordinary and tool-heavy assignments are mixed. Never infer a class from response speed, wording, or requested ability.

scenarios.situation: Players encounter the character without prior instruction.
observe: whether each player discovers an available way to address the character
time to discovery
help or surprises
constraints: allow two minutes before public help
do not coach away a failed discovery

scenarios.situation: A player asks for advice that can be interpreted using the approved public persona and premise brief.
observe: whether the reply addresses the situation
persona and premise fit
whether uncertainty is explained

scenarios.situation: A player refers to a detail from an earlier exchange in the same conversation.
observe: whether the reply uses the available context coherently
whether missing or stale context is handled honestly
constraints: use only the supported limited follow-up grammar
do not treat a receipt as a relevant answer

scenarios.situation: Player A and Player B discuss a shared fictional fact in one game session.
observe: whether the same shared game route is used
whether attribution and context remain coherent for both players
constraints: do not require a scripted fact or reply

scenarios.situation: Relevant captured attention is incomplete or old when a player asks about it.
observe: whether age and loss limits are represented honestly
whether the character avoids claiming continuous awareness
constraints: do not infer facts that were not captured

scenarios.situation: A player asks for an effect or ability the server does not provide.
observe: whether the limitation is clearly explained
whether the reply avoids claiming an unverified effect
constraints: do not grant or simulate a game ability

scenarios.situation: The situation changes after an earlier request, or an earlier fact is no longer current.
observe: whether the reply distinguishes known facts from stale context
whether it avoids presenting old context as current

scenarios.situation: One player makes seven repeat attempts in six seconds while another player asks a distinct question.
observe: per-invocation dispositions and retained-request linkage
whether the distinct player's request remains separately attributable
bounded progress and terminal outcomes
constraints: do not add load or retry automatically
retain rejected and coalesced attempts in totals

scenarios.situation: A request experiences bounded delay or a safe technical failure.
observe: first-dispatch latency
truthful queued or awaiting-answer progress
terminal or unresolved outcome
constraints: progress is not a completed answer
do not claim model or tool activity

scenarios.situation: Each player chooses at least one exchange without a prescribed question or expected answer.
observe: relevance, coherence, enjoyment and unexpected problems
whether the character stays within its approved premise
constraints: no LLM judge or automatic quality pass

scenarios.situation: A future publicly supported game capability requires explicit tool work under separately approved bounds.
observe: whether the approved capability is available
whether progress and terminal outcomes remain bounded and truthful
constraints: do not run while tool support is unavailable or unapproved
do not infer work class from response speed, wording, or an unavailable ability
